ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels accounting for approximately 85% of surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed across the remaining 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Deep black/charcoal base layer. High-contrast white focal spots are scattered globally, with increased density at the distal tips. Distinct contiguous white mottling is observed along the lower leading edge of the left lobe and inner margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 75-degree V-shaped central depression with a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations across both lobes. Right lobe exhibits three prominent macro-level peaks (points) along the distal third of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with a pronounced concave arc along the trailing edge leading to tapered, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of circular white pixel clusters (2-10 pixel radius) across the ventral surface, appearing as high-contrast 'halos' or solid dots indicative of prior barnacle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly vertical parallel white lines on the lower left lobe; multiple intersecting diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) on the lower right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-directional linear scarring and circular pitting consistent with cetacean rake marks and barnacle colonization across 40% of the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'grid-like' intersection of linear scars located in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
